newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AUG CORE INFLATION DOWN 0.1 PCT YR/YR -SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AUG CORE INFLATION DOWN 0.1 PCT YR/YR -SF.

text.p: Finnish core inflation fell 0.1 percent year-on-year in August after being unchanged in July, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Tuesday.
The mean of six economists' forecasts for the August core inflation figure was a 0.1 percent rise in a -0.1-+0.2 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- the central bank's chief gauge for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
